description: Research themes, each with the ADS bibcodes of its papers (see src/content/publications/). Theme titles approved by Matthew Payne on 2026-10-14. Every refereed paper should appear in exactly one theme or in `other`; the Research page build warns about any that do not.

themes.title: Planet formation in binaries and disks
themes.summary: Forming planets around brown dwarfs, in binary star systems and in gravitationally unstable disks.

themes.title: Exoplanet dynamics, TTVs and radial velocities
themes.summary: Resonances and stability in multi-planet systems, transit timing variations, and N-body modelling of radial-velocity data, from resonance overlap and 55 Cancri to Gliese 876 and RUN DMC.

themes.title: Exomoons and satellite stability
themes.summary: Whether moons survive in closely packed planetary systems and around white dwarfs.

themes.title: Debris disks
themes.summary: Planetesimal belts and what they reveal about unseen planets, including ALMA observations of Fomalhaut and HD 141569.

themes.title: The outer Solar System
themes.summary: Planet Nine, trans-Neptunian objects, Neptune Trojans, Centaurs and the DECam Ecliptic Exploration Project (DEEP).

links.label: Interactive: Jupiter’s Trojans and Hildas in five reference frames

themes.title: Detection and linking methods
themes.summary: Finding and characterising small bodies in survey data: HelioLinC, digest2, machine learning for near-Earth objects, shift-and-stack, the ASSIST integrator and IAWN timing campaigns.
